title: 第2645章 我更希望自己亲手拿回大权第2644章 三姓家奴窦天罡之死
lines: “噗嗤！”
随着窦天罡身死，以及苍隗三道身外化身陨落。
这场战争也接近尾声。
窦天罡麾下的六十万仙奴军，被人族军团尽数覆灭。
天冥老祖腾空而起，看向唐明的目光充满了感激。
“唐道友，多谢此番出手，镇杀苍隗分身，还替天冥城解决了窦天罡这个叛徒。”
天冥老祖双手抱拳道谢。
“无妨，举手之劳而已。”
唐明淡淡一笑。
这话，让天冥老祖微微一愣，他虽然是半途赶来，但也亲眼见证了唐明击杀苍隗三道分身的过程。
就算只是分身。
那也是拥有寻常太虚战力的分身。
就算让天冥老祖全力出手，估计也得手段齐出才能将其镇杀。
但唐明呢？
一个人轻松将苍隗三具分身镇杀，而后还将其灵韵吞噬。
更何况。
唐明旁边还有一尊上古镇守使的残魂。
“拜见轩辕前辈。”
天冥老祖再次抱拳行礼。
轩辕灏淡漠的瞥了他一眼：“你就是鬼域的幽冥共主？”
“不敢当。”天冥老祖赶忙道：“我只是偶得上一任幽冥共主的传承。”
轩辕灏意味深长地看过来：“在上古时代，人王殿统御三界，幽冥共主之位想要名正言顺，也得需要人王的首肯。”
天冥老祖瞳孔微缩。
他有些不敢接这话……毕竟，这关乎幽冥界域的统治问题。
再者。
上古早已破碎，人王殿也早已失传万年，昔日的规矩能否用在当下局势，也是两难之说……
“轩辕前辈，你且回去休息吧，刚才一战多谢相助。”
唐明忽然开口。
轩辕灏身形很快消散。
content_en:
"Pfft!"
With the death of Dou Tiangang, the three external incarnations of Cang Wei fell.
This war is also coming to an end.
The 600,000 Immortal slaves under Dou Tiangang's command were all wiped out by the human army.
"Uh-huh!"
Ancestor Tian Ming rose into the sky and looked at Tang Ming with eyes filled with gratitude.
"Fellow Daoist Tang, thank you very much for taking this action, killing Cang Wei's clone, and also taking care of the traitor Dou Tiangang on behalf of Tianming City."
Ancestor Tian Ming clasped his hands in his fists and thanked him.
"It doesn't matter, it's just a little effort."
Tang Ming smiled lightly.
These words made Patriarch Tian Ming slightly stunned. Although he came halfway, he also witnessed with his own eyes the process of Tang Ming killing Cang Wei's three clones.
Even if it's just a clone.
That is also a clone with ordinary Taixu combat power.
Even if Patriarch Tian Ming were to attack with all his strength, he would probably have to use all his means to kill him.
But what about Tang Ming?
One person easily killed Cang Wei's three clones, and then devoured their aura.
not to mention.
Next to Tang Ming was the remnant soul of an ancient guardian envoy.
"Meet Senior Xuanyuan."
Ancestor Tian Ming once again cupped his fists and saluted.
Xuanyuan Hao glanced at him indifferently: "Are you the Netherworld Co-Master of the Ghost Realm?"
"I don't dare to take it." Ancestor Tianming said hurriedly: "I just happened to have the inheritance of the previous Nether Co-Master."
Xuanyuan Hao looked over meaningfully: "In ancient times, the Human King's Palace ruled the three realms. If the position of co-lord of the Netherworld is to be legitimate, it must also require the approval of the Human King."
Ancestor Tian Ming’s pupils shrank slightly.
He was a little afraid to accept these words... After all, this was related to the governance of the Netherworld.
Again.
The ancient times have long been broken, and the Human King Palace has been lost for thousands of years. Whether the rules of the past can be used in the current situation is also a dilemma...
"Senior Xuanyuan, please go back and rest. Thank you for your help in the battle just now."
Tang Ming suddenly spoke.
"Okay."
Xuanyuan Hao's figure quickly disappeared.
title_en: Chapter 2645 I prefer to take back the power with my own hands Chapter 2644 The death of Dou Tiangang, the slave of the third surname
